result.instructions: Tools for Fiken, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which invoices are past due and not yet paid?"; "Which supplier bills are still unpaid?"; "What are my bank balances today?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Fiken data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fiken_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fiken_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fiken_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fiken_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fiken_get_user
tools.title: Get the signed-in user
tools.description: The Fiken user this connection acts as (name and email). A cheap check that the sign-in works. Fiken: GET /user.

tools.name: fiken_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: The Fiken companies this connection can access, with their slug (needed as companySlug in every other tool), organization number and VAT type. Companies created after you approved access must be added under Fiken > Rediger konto > Sikkerhet > Apper du har gitt tilgang til. Fiken: GET /companies.

tools.name: fiken_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: One company: name, organization number, VAT type, address, accounting start date and whether the API module is active. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

tools.name: fiken_list_accounts
tools.title: List chart-of-accounts accounts
tools.description: The bookkeeping accounts (kontoplan) of the current year. Filter with range, e.g. "3000-3999, 1920". Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/accounts.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

fromAccount.description: First account number to include, e.g. 3000.

toAccount.description: Last account number to include, e.g. 3999.

range.description: Comma-separated account numbers or ranges, e.g. "1000-1500, 2000, 7000-7004".

tools.name: fiken_get_account_balances
tools.title: Get account balances on a date
tools.description: Closing balance of every bookkeeping account on a date (amounts in cents). Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/accountBalances.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

annotations.title: Get account balances on a date

tools.name: fiken_list_bank_accounts
tools.title: List bank accounts
tools.description: The company's bank accounts as registered in Fiken. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/bankAccounts.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

inactive.description: true = only inactive bank accounts, false = only active ones.

tools.name: fiken_get_bank_balances
tools.title: Get bank balances
tools.description: Bank account balances, optionally on a given date (amounts in cents). Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/bankBalances.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

tools.name: fiken_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts (customers and suppliers)
tools.description: Customers and suppliers. Filter by name, organization number, email, customer/supplier flag or modification date. contactId in the result is the id other tools take as customerId/contactId. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/contacts.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

inactive.description: true = only inactive contacts, false = only active.

tools.name: fiken_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: One customer or supplier with address, contact persons, notes and account codes. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/contacts/{contactId}.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

tools.name: fiken_list_invoices
tools.title: List issued invoices
tools.description: Issued (final) invoices with sale lines, amounts in cents and settled status. Filter by issue date, due date, customer and whether settled. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/invoices.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

settled.description: true = only settled (paid) invoices, false = only unsettled ones.

tools.name: fiken_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: One issued invoice with lines, customer, amounts in cents, settled status and payment/credit-note links. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/invoices/{invoiceId}.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

tools.name: fiken_list_invoice_drafts
tools.title: List invoice drafts
tools.description: Drafts of invoices, offers, order confirmations and credit notes that are not issued yet (a draft has a draftId, an invoice has an invoiceId). Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/invoices/drafts.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

tools.description: Issued credit notes. Fiken: GET /companies/{companySlug}/creditNotes.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

customerId.description: Only credit notes to this contactId.

settled.description: true = only settled, false = only unsettled.

tools.name: fiken_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a customer and/or supplier contact. Set customer=true to invoice it later. The new contactId comes back in `id`. Fiken: POST /companies/{companySlug}/contacts.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

customer.description: true if the contact is a customer (needed before you can invoice it).

supplier.description: true if the contact is a supplier.

language.description: Language of documents sent to this contact.

daysUntilInvoicingDueDate.description: Default days until the due date.

country.description: Country name as Fiken expects it, e.g. Norway (required in an address).

tools.name: fiken_create_product
tools.title: Create a product
tools.description: Add a product or service to the product register, for use on invoice lines. incomeAccount is a revenue account such as 3000 (see fiken_list_accounts). Fiken: POST /companies/{companySlug}/products.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

unitPrice.description: Net unit price (excl. VAT), an integer in cents (100000 = 1000.00 kr).

incomeAccount.description: Revenue account that receives the income, e.g. 3000.

vatType.description: VAT type, HIGH (25 %) is the most common.

active.description: Whether the product is in use.

tools.name: fiken_create_invoice_draft
tools.title: Create an invoice draft
tools.description: Create a DRAFT of an invoice, offer or order confirmation. A draft is not issued, not booked and not sent; it can be edited or deleted in Fiken. The draft's id comes back in `id`. To issue it use fiken_issue_invoice_from_draft (type invoice only). Amounts are integers in cents. Fiken: POST /companies/{companySlug}/invoices/drafts.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

type.description: Kind of document the draft becomes.

customerId.description: The contactId of the customer (a contact with customer=true).

daysUntilDueDate.description: Days from the issue date until the invoice is due.

bankAccountNumber.description: Bank account number to pay into.

contactPersonId.description: Contact person id of the customer.

productId.description: productId from fiken_list_products (supplies price, VAT and income account).

unitPrice.description: Net price per unit, an integer in cents (100000 = 1000.00 kr).

incomeAccount.description: Income account, if the line has no product.

tools.name: fiken_issue_invoice_from_draft
tools.title: Issue an invoice from a draft (IRREVERSIBLE)
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE. Turns an invoice draft into a real invoice: it gets the next invoice number and is booked in the ledger (accounts receivable and revenue, VAT). An issued invoice cannot be deleted, only corrected with a credit note. It is NOT sent to the customer: use fiken_send_invoice for that. Only call this when the user has clearly asked to issue this exact draft. Fiken: POST /companies/{companySlug}/invoices/drafts/{draftId}/createInvoice.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

draftId.description: The draftId from fiken_list_invoice_drafts or fiken_create_invoice_draft.

annotations.title: Issue an invoice from a draft (IRREVERSIBLE)

tools.name: fiken_send_invoice
tools.title: Send an invoice to the customer (IRREVERSIBLE)
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE. Delivers an issued invoice to the customer by email, EHF, eFaktura, SMS or physical letter (a letter costs extra and goes to Norwegian addresses only). A sent message cannot be recalled and Fiken records the invoice as sent. Only call this when the user has clearly asked to send this exact invoice to this recipient. method lists delivery channels in priority order; Fiken uses the first one that works. Fiken: POST /companies/{companySlug}/invoices/send.

companySlug.description: The company's slug: the `slug` field from fiken_list_companies (for example swagger-test-company).

invoiceId.description: The invoiceId of an ISSUED invoice (from fiken_list_invoices).

method.description: Delivery channels in priority order, e.g. ["email"]. "auto" picks from what the customer has registered.

includeDocumentAttachments.description: Include the invoice's attachments (not for letters).

message.description: Message sent along with the invoice.

emailSendOption.description: How an email carries the invoice.

mergeInvoiceAndAttachments.description: Merge invoice and attachments into one PDF (with emailSendOption=attachment).

organizationNumber.description: Recipient organization number (EHF); defaults to the customer's.

mobileNumber.description: Recipient mobile number (SMS); defaults to the customer's.

annotations.title: Send an invoice to the customer (IRREVERSIBLE)
